name: Wailing Caverns
summary: Steam wails through the bluffs above Lushwater Oasis. Beneath them, Naralex's hope of restoring the Barrens has turned the Wailing Caverns into a place of corruption and danger.

sections.title: The Druids of the Fang
sections.body:
Naralex's followers guard him while he sleeps in the Wailing Caverns. The Emerald Nightmare drove his closest disciples mad, and they abandoned their old traditions. Under leaders such as Lady Anacondra, they became the Druids of the Fang and took on venomous snake aspects. They defend their master from anyone who might break his trance.

Now the waterways threaten to poison oases across the Barrens. Cenarion Circle allies in Thunder Bluff are concerned, while goblins in Ratchet see an opportunity.

sections.title: The Dream Curdled
sections.body:
Steam bursts from underground geysers and escapes through cracks in the rock. Its mournful cries echo through the caverns. The night elf druid Naralex entered these deep waterways with his faithful followers, hoping to draw on the subterranean springs and channel the Emerald Dream. He sought to bring bloom to the barren savannas.

Instead, the Emerald Nightmare trapped Naralex's consciousness. Corruption seeps from the sleeping druid, warping the springs and changing local beasts into deviate horrors.

faq.q: Why is it called the Wailing Caverns?
faq.answer: Steam bursting through narrow cracks in the rock ceiling gives the Wailing Caverns their name. Its cries echo through the stone chambers.

faq.q: Who is Naralex and why is he sleeping here?
faq.answer: Naralex is a night elf druid who sought to turn the Barrens into lush woodland by joining its underground springs to the Emerald Dream. The Emerald Nightmare overwhelmed him in trance, and corruption now flows through him.

faq.q: What are the Druids of the Fang?
faq.answer: The Druids of the Fang are Naralex's former disciples, driven mad by the Emerald Nightmare while he slept. They took on serpent aspects, defend the corrupted caverns, and seek to spread their warped vision of nature.

faq.q: Why are the beasts inside called 'deviate'?
faq.answer: Naralex's corruption tainted the springs and changed ordinary raptors, crocolisks, and vipers into deviate forms. Their strange coloring, heightened aggression, and unusual scales and hides mark the change.

angles.text: As a druid, you see in the Wailing Caverns how good intentions can be corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare. Naralex must be awakened, or his twisted disciples put to rest.
For the Horde, tainted waters threaten the fragile oases that sustain life and travel across the Barrens. Cleansing the caves is urgent for the safety of nearby settlements.
